## Detailed Project Case Studies

### 1. Shefware Suite (Cloud Migration & Enterprise .NET / Java)
- Client: Shefware Solutions (shefware.com)
- Scope: High-volume mailbox data ingestion, conversion, and multi-tenant cloud migration platform.
- Engineering Highlights: Handled over 10M+ items with zero packet loss and 99.98% pipeline uptime. Implemented resilient batch streaming, exponential backoff retries, and rate-limiting compliant with Microsoft Graph and Google Workspace APIs.
- Tech Stack: .NET Core, C#, Java, Spring Boot, Docker, OAuth2, Cloud Streams.

### 2. Nexus Platform (Full Stack & Mobile Architecture)
- Scope: Omnichannel mobile and web portal serving real-time customer data.
- Engineering Highlights: Built with Next.js and React Native, achieving 85% business logic code reuse across mobile and web platforms. Maintained sub-80ms global API latency using localized Redis caching and PostgreSQL read replicas.
- Tech Stack: Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, Redis, PostgreSQL.

### 3. Mindspace Arch (DevOps & Cloud Telemetry)
- Scope: Developer experience dashboard and distributed cluster orchestration system.
- Engineering Highlights: Reduced build and release cycles by 70% with automated GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows and blue/green Kubernetes container deployments.
- Tech Stack: Java, Docker, Kubernetes, Figma UI/UX, TypeScript.
